metadata.title: Formal Estate Portrait with Compressed Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A centered full-body portrait of a formally dressed figure against a deep one-point perspective landscape, framed by ultra-narrow serif typography at the top corners.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length figure in black formal attire stands slightly off-center on a wide gravel path that recedes toward a distant castle. The composition is defined by a high horizon line and a vast, pale sky, with typography placed in the upper left and right corners to balance the verticality of the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject verticality echoing the distant castle towers
Gravel path leading the eye from foreground to deep background
Typography anchored to the top edge to frame the sky
Contrast between the dark silhouette of the figure and the pale sky

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure, medium-large scale, positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame, slightly right of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, solid mass of the black overcoat and top hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the figure's face, moves down the coat to the path, follows the path to the castle, and ends at the corner typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive pale sky in the upper third and wide gravel path in the lower foreground.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Narrowed 'O' and 'G' to match stem widths
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospaced weight across two distinct phrases in opposite corners.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast serifs.
Captures the elegant, formal modern serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a man in a black Victorian morning suit and top hat standing on a long gravel driveway that recedes into the distance toward a grey stone castle. The scene should be flanked by green trees under a flat, overcast sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif text in all-caps in the top left and top right corners, rendered in solid black.

verificationChecks: Subject is in full formal attire

adjustableVariables: Specific style of the top hat
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any recognizable brand logos on the clothing
Specific architectural details of the background estate
postGenerationChecks: Is the text perfectly horizontal and anchored to the corners?
Does the path lead directly to a central vanishing point?
Is the figure's silhouette sharp against the pale background?
Are the serifs on the font visible and sharp?
recipe.reuseFormula: Formal Portrait + Deep Perspective Path + Corner-Anchored Compressed Serifs
